visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A dark, high-contrast monochromatic engraving depicting a nighttime scene in a rugged, possibly wooded or hilly landscape. To the left, a third figure stands more calmly, holding a long object, possibly a rifle or staff.

The visual depicts an outdoor rocky landscape with a leaping figure in mid-air and widely separated individuals, rather than the intimate, close-quarters ambush described.
